info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Approved Supplier Validation API
info.description: The Approved Supplier Validation API enables businesses to validate suppliers within the Approved Supplier Directory. This endpoint facilitates the submission of validation requests for specific suppliers identified by unique parameters. Typical consumers include procurement teams and compliance officers tasked with ensuring supplier legitimacy and adherence to company standards. By leveraging this API, organizations can streamline their supplier onboarding process and maintain an up-to-date directory of validated suppliers.

post.summary: Validate an approved supplier directory entry.
post.description: This endpoint validates the entry for an approved supplier in the specified approved supplier directory. This ensures the data integrity and correctness of supplier information before processing further actions.
